prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: flat game character armour UV colour atlas. Input image 1 is the exact edit target, helmet_techarmour.png, original 512x256. Repaint this existing Anarchy Online armour texture with crisp contemporary game-quality craftsmanship while preserving its ORIGINAL DESIGN. Keep every panel, seam, emblem, decorative shape, fastener, island boundary, empty region and their exact normalized positions; unchanged proportions and orientation. Preserve the original warm bronze and black colour palette. Upgrade the visible material workmanship with smooth coated armour plates, fine recessed seams, refined machining only where appropriate, and detailed dark flexible joints. Carefully keep small characteristic motifs identical. This is the same recognisable AO armour at higher fidelity, no restyling. Paint diffuse base colour under neutral flat illumination, no baked glare, metallic reflections, dramatic shadows, or new glowing elements. No added objects, rearrangement, text, borders, white margins or presentation mockup. Fill the complete canvas; stretch the UV layout to full canvas if needed, it will be resized back to original aspect ratio. Do not turn dark fabric/rubber into shiny metal. No uniform speckle or excessive scratches.
